subject: maths
title: Sine Rule, Cosine Rule and Triangle Area
welcome_lead: Solve any triangle with the sine and cosine rules - even non-right ones.
meta_desc: Maths adventure on sine rule, cosine rule and ½ab sin C area formula.
final_note: Sine rule for opposite pairs, cosine rule when you know two sides!

concepts.def: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C.
Area = ½ab sin C with included angle C.
Sine rule may give two valid triangles.
Two sides + included angle - use cosine rule.
Two angles + a side - use sine rule.

walkthroughs.body_html:
In triangle ABC, A = 40°, a = 7, B = 60°. Find b.

b/sin 60° = 7/sin 40°, so b = 7 sin 60° / sin 40° ≈ 9.43.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between congruent and similar shapes?
options: Congruent shapes are similar with different angles.
Congruent and similar both mean 'the same shape' — they're interchangeable.
Congruent shapes are identical in size and shape; similar shapes have the same shape but can be different sizes (scaled).

mcqs.q: If 5 pens cost £3.50, how much do 7 pens cost?
options: £24.50, by multiplying £3.50 by 7.
£5.50, by adding £2 to £3.50 because there are 2 more pens.
5.33, by dividing 80 by 15.
£4.90 — find the unit cost (£0.70 per pen), then multiply by 7.
